title: Cards that count a Unit's death read what the card was as it died
notes: Corpse Eater (Core #89 and TG #56), Corpse Recycler, Recessive Replicators, Eschews, The Greatest Heist's Stage 2 and Shadowstep's base face read a death as a Unit's by what the card was on the field as it died, from the destroyed event's new diedAs (R4423000): a Unit set by its Cloaked and destroyed before it reveals is none, an Animated Field Spell or Trap killed in a unit zone is one. The scripts of v0.6.9i are kept (script_v0_6_9i) for v0.6.9j and before.

player.title: Deaths count by what the card was as it died
fixes: A Unit set face-down with Cloaked and destroyed before it revealed was a Trap, yet Corpse Eater, Corpse Recycler, Recessive Replicators, Eschews, The Greatest Heist and Shadowstep counted it.
An Animated Field Spell or Trap killed in a unit zone was a Unit there, but only Shadowstep counted its death. Corpse Eater, Corpse Recycler, Recessive Replicators and Eschews now count it too.
